facts.statement: Hintighernia was described by Pêgas and colleagues.
Hintighernia is a new genus and new species.
The type locality of Hintighernia is the Cambridge Greensand.
Hintighernia was found in the United Kingdom.
Hintighernia lived during the Cretaceous period.
Hintighernia is classified as a member of the family Tapejaridae.
facts.quote: A member of the family Tapejaridae.

facts.statement: The partial cranium CAMSM B54406, previously referred to as Ornithostoma sedgwicki, is identified as a sinopterine tapejarid.
The new species is named Hintighernia edingerae.
Micro-CT scanning shows that the neuroanatomy of Hintighernia closely resembles that of Tapejara wellnhoferi.
Ornithostoma sedgwicki is considered a chaoyangopterid azhdarchoid known only from four jaw fragments.
Researchers suggest the existence of a third azhdarchoid species in the Cambridge Greensand based on jaw and cervical remains.
